../sources/hotdog-round3-pet.webp.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent game sprite sheet
Primary request: Reproduce the exact Hotdog character in the reference as four clear full-body game poses in a horizontal strip, in order: think, dance-star, giggle, catch-toy. Hotdog is a very low fluffy quadruped with stripes pink, orange, yellow, lime, blue, lavender; huge gray ears edged navy; navy face mask; red forehead heart; red/orange/yellow flame tuft; tiny navy paws; long striped tail.
Style/medium: bold smooth dark navy outlines, expressive eyes, bright original colors, simple clean cel shading matching the supplied 2D canonical art.
Composition/framing: four discrete equal-width cells, generous transparent gutters, full animal in every cell; same neutral head size and character scale in all cells. Think: low stance, head tilted and one tiny paw lightly touching cheek, eyes looking up. Dance-star: tiny joyous squat-hop with a friendly star-shaped silhouette made by its ears/feet/body, no actual star icon. Giggle: delighted eyes closed, mouth open, soft floppy-body wiggle while all four paws remain grounded. Catch-toy: low playful pounce, front paws and mouth reaching forward, with nothing visible to catch.
Scene/backdrop: transparent.
Constraints: exact identity from input reference, keep character on four legs, no biped standing; never enlarge head/body in crouched poses. Keep same stripe order/colors, outline, and proportions. No baked-in props.
Avoid: food hot dog, human hands, shuffled/missing stripes, visible toy, floating decorations, shadow, motion marks, text, watermark.

Constraints: Use reference as exact identity source, preserve same proportions and palette. Make emotions clear and distinct.
Avoid: full body, added clothing, food imagery, extra animal/characters, shuffled stripes, cropped ears or tuft, effects, background, text, watermark.

../sources/hotdog-pull-low-paws-oct12.we.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: transparent two-frame game sprite strip, one row of two complete characters, generous transparent gutters, no labels.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved Hotdog canonical identity reference. Image 2 is the edit target for frame 1; Image 3 is the edit target for frame 2.
Primary request: Redraw ONLY the front arms/paws on both tug-of-war poses, lowering their joined empty gripping paws from directly under the muzzle to chest/belly height. Keep both faces completely visible ABOVE the imaginary horizontal rope line. The grip should be about 30–35 percent of body height above the grounded rear feet, below the chin and white upper chest, not up by the face. Draw no rope or prop. Frame 1 is braced with open determined eyes and a small backward lean. Frame 2 is a stronger backward tug with squeezed-closed eyes. Both point toward screen-right, sit back on their planted hind feet and grip forward with their blue front paws at belly level. Maintain essentially the same torso/head shape, upright flame tuft, ear proportions, pink heart forehead marking, huge amber eyes, blue paws, white chest, fluffy multicolor tail, exact yellow-orange-hot-pink-lime-lavender-blue striped fur, navy outlines, clean cel shading, full body and complete tail.
Constraints: The camera, identity, silhouette apart from the lowered arms, head scale and pose order must match the two edit targets; Image 1 sets the exact canonical colors and anatomy. The ears/flame tuft remain large; do not redesign as a different creature. Anatomically exactly two front paws in front and two planted rear feet, no extra hands. Empty joined gripping blue paws held well below the face. No rope, no scenery, no text, no decorative effects, no contact shadow, no background. True transparent alpha. Consistent drawing scale in both cells, side-by-side distinct sprites with enough gap that all ears and tails are complete.
